1inch DeFi wallet is a non-custodial wallet. 1inch DeFi wallet supports multiple blockchain networks. 1inch DeFi wallet provides integrated token swapping through the 1inch aggregator.

JupiterZ operates on the Solana blockchain. JupiterZ supplies liquidity to the Jupiter aggregator through professional market makers.

1inch Card is a payment card linked to the 1inch wallet. 1inch Card allows users to spend crypto assets for everyday purchases.
